title: SiGMA: Learning under Graph-Level Heterogeneity with Gated Message-Passing and Attention
abstract: arXiv:2503.00547v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In graph-level learning, graph neural networks are typically applied with a fixed computational template: the same depth, local message-passing operator, and global attention mechanism are used for every input graph. However, different graphs within the same dataset can vary substantially in prediction difficulty and may require different mixtures of local and non-local computation. We study this phenomenon as graph-level heterogeneity in both classification and regression tasks. To address it, we propose SiGMA (Sigmoid Gated Message-Passing and Attention), a gated hybrid graph neural network architecture that combines message-passing and attention heads within each layer. translated_title: SiGMA：基于门控消息传递与注意力机制的图级异质性学习
translated_abstract: 在图级学习中，图神经网络通常采用固定的计算模板：对每个输入图使用相同的网络深度、相同的局部消息传递算子以及相同的全局注意力机制。然而，同一数据集中的不同图在预测难度上可能存在显著差异，并且可能需要不同比例的局部与非局部计算。我们将这一现象作为图级异质性在分类和回归任务中进行了研究。为解决该问题，我们提出了SiGMA（Sigmoid门控消息传递与注意力），这是一种门控混合图神经网络架构，它在每一层内将消息传递与注意力头相结合。受大语言模型和视觉Transformer中门控注意力与门控计算日益广泛应用启发，SiGMA中的每个头都由一个可学习的节点级sigmoid门进行调制，使模型能够自适应地调节使用局部还是全局机制来完成计算。
tldr: 提出了SiGMA门控混合图神经网络架构，通过可学习的节点级sigmoid门控自适应融合消息传递与注意力机制，以应对不同图需要不同局部与全局计算组合的图级异质性问题。
en_tdlr: SiGMA is a gated hybrid graph neural network that adaptively balances message-passing and attention through learned node-wise sigmoid gates to address graph-level heterogeneity.
